English.Keywords: macOS, menu bar, productivity, HUD, iStat Menus alternative, system monitor, calendar, Notion
English.Char_Desc_45: Daily productivity HUD and menu bar daemon
English.Char_Desc_80: Unified daily productivity heads-up display and menu bar daemon for Mac/Win.
English.Char_Desc_250: Cockpit merges calendar events, system telemetry (CPU, RAM, disk, network), Notion workspaces, and daily dial scheduling into a sleek floating HUD and menu bar item with sub-millisecond responsiveness (<0.1% CPU).
English.Char_Desc_2000: Cockpit is an all-in-one daily productivity heads-up display and menu bar control surface built for macOS and Windows. Written natively with zero Electron, zero webviews, and zero background tracking, it unifies your daily schedule, project workspaces, and hardware metrics in a clean, distraction-free popover. Free and open source under MIT.
